CITY OF ALHAMBRA DESIGN REVIEW BOARD
  MINUTES
  Regular Meeting
  December 14, 2021

  •  CALL MEETING TO ORDER: 7:30 P.M. via video conference and teleconference

  •  ROLL CALL:
  Present: Ankit Udani, Stanley Tsai, Nora Hernandez, Michael Daninger
  •  Absent: Jose Luis Espinoza
  Staff Present: Richard Abe AIA, Erin Ung, Vist Yang

CONSENT AGENDA

ITEM 1:
MINUTES: November 9, 2021
Recommended Action: Design Review Board review and approve as submitted the minutes of the
November 9, 2021 regular meeting of the Design Review Board.

ITEM 2:
500 South Marengo Avenue
This is an application for exterior color changes to an existing commercial building for a business
known as "Home Depot".
Applicant: Vanessa Bowling
Recommended Action: APPROVAL - Recommendation is for approval.

MOTION:
 •  Hernandez moved to approve the consent agenda as submitted.
 •  The second was by Tsai.
 •  The motion carried 4-0 with the following roll call vote:

Ayes: Ankit Udani, Nora Hernandez, Stanley Tsai, Michael Daninger
Absent: Jose Luis Espinoza

  1
 DISCUSSION AGENDA:

ITEM 3:
APPLICANT: 803 North Dos Robles

Recommended Action: Recommendation is for approval.

The applicant Christine Feller was present for Item number 3 and the staff report was given.
There were no public comments and there were no comments submitted by email prior to the
meeting.

Hernandez confirmed the elements of the proposal. She had no comments.
Daninger had no comments.
Tsai questioned the location of the fence. The applicant stated that it was on the side property
along the driveway. He also confirmed the river rock was to retain dirt to allow a flat lawn. Tsai
was only concerned re drainage.
Udani had no comments and called for a motion.

MOTION:
 •  Hernandez moved to approve the application as submitted.
 •  The second was by Tsai.
 •  The motion carried 4-0 with the following roll call vote:

Ayes: Ankit Udani, Nora Hernandez, Stanley Tsai, Michael Daninger
Absent: Jose Luis Espinoza

ITEM 4:
APPLICANT: 429 North Ethel Avenue
Recommended Action: Recommendation is for approval.

The applicant George Robles was present for Item number 4 and the staff report was given.
There were no public comments and there were no comments submitted by email prior to the
meeting

Tsai stated that he was accepting of the design.

Daninger had no comments.

Hernandez stated that in deference to Tsai we could make a condition to match the height of the
neighbor.

Udani called for a motion.

  2
 MOTION:
 •  Tsai moved to approve the application with the condition that the applicant work with staff
  to ensure compatibility with the height of the adjacent neighbor.
 •  The second was by Hernandez.
 •  The motion carried 4-0 with the following roll call vote:

Ayes: Ankit Udani, Nora Hernandez, Stanley Tsai, Michael Daninger
Absent: Jose Luis Espinoza

ITEM 5:
APPLICANT: 505 South Cordova Street
Recommended Action: Recommendation is for approval with the condition that all existing
site walls shall be documented on the drawings.

The applicant Ray Camus stated prior to the meeting that he was withdrawing this application
from consideration. There was no action taken on this item.

ITEM 6:
APPLICANT: 918-924 East Main Street
Recommended Action: Recommendation is for approval with the condition that all existing
site walls shall be documented on the drawings.

The applicant Carl Wong and his architect Skylar Kogachi were present for Item number 6 and the
staff report was given.

PUBLIC COMMENTS:

Olga Alarid spoke in favor of the project. Stating that there was a good collaboration between the
developer, the architect and the local community group. She stated that Carl was wonderful to
work with and fully supported the building development.

Brad Michaels spoke in support for the right development. He stated that it embodied their vision
and he gave it a green light for the project.

Angela Babcock spoke for the Alhambra Main Street Alliance and supported the project and gave
a description of how the developer worked with the local community.

Louis McCammon spoke of the good changes that were made. The “brick tile” is consistent with
the pre-existing character. It should enhance the community. The building does not impede the
view from the neighbors.

  3
 Ari Arambula stated that she concurred with her neighbors. The meeting was critical and a good
model for development. The cooperation of all players were appropriate and beneficial. It is
hopeful that the City would support the business and use.

John Bwarie spoke as CEO of the Alhambra Chamber of Commerce. He supported the project and
spoke of the cooperation of the developer and the value of the project.

Michael McCollum stated that he was the owner of the co-working space on Alhambra Rd. He
complimented the process and the players involved.

END OF PUBLIC COMMENTS

Hernandez had no questions but agreed with the comments from both the community and the
Design Review Board. The contrast between the varied iterations show great progress.

Tsai stated that the front elevation is much improved. The rear elevation with the block wall at the
lower level could be covered in stucco to make a more consistent appearance. Lighting would also
be a welcome addition.

Daninger stated his support and questioned if there are gates planned for the rear automobile access.

The architect stated that they would consider the security issues and would also consider the
stucco finish as mentioned.

Udani stated his support for the project and called for a motion.

Hernandez stated that the alley is a common walkway for Granada School students so landscape
may be helpful as well.

The architect stated that landscape was sacrificed as the project went from 3 stories to 2 stories.
MOTION:
  •  Tsai moved to approve the application with the following conditions: 1.) Work with staff
  regarding stucco over the CMU on the rear elevation and; 2.) Work with staff to explore
  possible landscape on the rear elevation.
  •  The second was by Hernandez.
  •  The motion carried 4-0 with the following roll call vote:

Ayes: Ankit Udani, Nora Hernandez, Stanley Tsai, Michael Daninger
Absent: Jose Luis Espinoza

ITEM 7: APPLICANT: 1225 South Stoneman

  4
 Recommended Action: Recommendation is for approval.

The applicant Mai Lam was present for Item number 4.

Tsai had questions that were addressed by the daughter of the owner.

Daninger had no comments

Hernandez questioned the style of the fence to be consistent with the neighboring houses.

Udani called for a motion.

MOTION:
 •  Nora Hernandez moved to approved the application with the following conditions: 1. Any
  gates shall be code compliant; and 2. Applicant shall work with staff on the the design for
  consistency with the fence including existing side yard fence and gates.
 •  The second was by Tsai.

Ayes: Ankit Udani, Nora Hernandez, Stanley Tsai, Michael Daninger
Absent: Jose Luis Espinoza

ITEM 8:
APPLICANT: 1301 West Valley Boulevard
Recommended Action: Recommendation is for approval with the following conditions: 1. The
LED panel on sign A is disallowed; 2. The color of the suspended raceway shall be specified to
match the wall color behind; and 3. All design changes shall be documented and reviewed by DRB
staff prior to Building Department submittal.

The applicant was absent for Item number 8.

Udani called for a motion.

MOTION:
 •  Nora Hernandez moved to continue the application.
 •  The second was by Tsai.

Ayes: Ankit Udani, Nora Hernandez, Stanley Tsai, Michael Daninger
Absent: Jose Luis Espinoza

ITEM 9:
APPLICANT: 1900 South Meridian Avenue
Recommended Action: Recommendation is for approval as submitted.

  5
 Tsai questioned why the dormers were not even.

The applicant stated it was to accommodate egress.

Udani questioned the materials and confirmed that the house is being repainted but in the same
white color. He then called for a motion.

MOTION:
 •  Tsai moved to approve the application with the condition that the applicant work with staff
  on the possible centering of the second floor dormers on the existing gable.
 •  The second was by Hernandez.
 •  The motion carried 4-0 by the following roll call vote.

Ayes: Ankit Udani, Nora Hernandez, Stanley Tsai, Michael Daninger
Absent: Jose Luis Espinoza

ITEM 10:
APPLICANT: 2505 West Valley Boulevard
Recommended Action: Recommendation is for approval as submitted.

John Bwarie , CEO of the Alhambra Chamber of Commerce spoke in favor of the application. Due
to Covid, the addition of the outdoor dining is helping restaurants during this time.

Daninger questioned the renderings. The applicant stated that the renderings were to show the
finished design.

Hernandez questioned if the roof covering was permanent. The applicant stated that it could be
open or closed. Since the drawings do not show a structural covering it can be assumed that it is
temporary.

Tsai stated that the colors should be specified as it relates to the covering. The applicant stated that
the covering would be sheer.

Udani also wanted clarification on the roof covering but is not specified anywhere.

The applicant may propose a separate application for the patio covering. Udani stated that it
should be removed completely unless it is going to be delayed for a year or two.

Abe questioned the applicant’s timeline and he stated that it would be done concurrent with the
patio construction.

Udani called for a motion.

  6
 MOTION:
 •  Hernandez moved to approve the application with the condition that the applicant work
  with staff on the possible roof covering of the patio.
 •  The second was by Daninger.
 •  The motion carried 4-0 by the following roll call vote.

Ayes: Ankit Udani, Nora Hernandez, Stanley Tsai, Michael Daninger
Absent: Jose Luis Espinoza

ITEM 11:
APPLICANT: 2810 West Alhambra Road
Recommended Action: Recommendation is for approval as submitted.

The applicant Swain Signs was present for Item number 11 and the staff report was given.
There were no public comments and there were no comments submitted by email prior to the
meeting.

Tsai had no comments.
Daninger had no comments.
Hernandez had no comments on the design.

The applicant stated it was a nation wide rebrand.

Udani called for a motion.

MOTION:
 •  Hernandez moved to approve the application as submitted.
 •  The second was by Tsai.
 •  The motion carried 4-0 by the following roll call vote.

Ayes: Ankit Udani, Nora Hernandez, Stanley Tsai, Michael Daninger
Absent: Jose Luis Espinoza

ITEM 12:
APPLICANT: 1719 South Second Street
Recommendation is for approval with the following condition(s): 1. The southeast corners of the
project buildings shall be revised for better integration of the associated elevations; 2. All revisions
shall be reviewed by staff prior to submittal for Planning Commission review; and 3. All landscape
plans shall be submitted for MWELO compliance as part of the building plan check submittal.

The applicant Robert Liu was present for Item number 12 and the staff report was given.

  7
 There were no public comments and there were no comments submitted by email prior to the
meeting.

The applicant stated that he was amenable to the staff conditions.

Hernandez was accepting of the design and stated that she agreed for the need to address the
southeast corner of the building.

Daninger questioned the location of utilities.

The applicant stated that the they would be located behind the garage out of public view.

Tsai stated that he had no comments on the design other than the south east corner.

Udani concurred and stated his support of the design and materials.

Udani called for a motion.

MOTION:
 •  Hernandez moved to approve the application with the conditions: 1. The southeast corners
  of the project buildings shall be revised for better integration of the associated elevations;
  2. All revisions shall be reviewed by staff prior to submittal for Planning Commission
  review; and 3. All landscape plans shall be submitted for MWELO compliance as part of
  the building plan check submittal.
 •  The second was by Tsai.
 •  The motion carried 4-0 by the following roll call vote.

  •  Nora Hernandez moved to adjourn the meeting at 9:00
  •  Seconded by Michael Daninger.
  •  The motion carried 4-0 by the following roll call vote:

Ayes: Ankit Udani, Nora Hernandez, Stanley Tsai
Absent: Jose Luis Espinoza

PASSED, APPROVED AND ADOPTED this 11th day of January, 2022.
